about: UNIT (c), 2026-11-23: Create Indicator's check of a script the assistant wrote (scriptAnswer.js::checkScript) runs in the member door's workers where there are workers (authoring/scriptCheckOffThread.js): the page's shared build of the text, PasteBox's shared report, and the status the report's worker makes of the two. Nothing of it is computed on the page's main thread; the door and the report are waited for themselves and only the hub's own step is bounded (HUB_STATUS_WAIT_MS); a fault of the window is refused by name and never sent to the assistant; the member's Stop ends the wait. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.
